_comment: The stamped LINKED tier: how many matched translation units actually reach the
PC port's binary. This is a STAMP, not a live counter, and it cannot be anything
else from main: port/tools/linkage.py reads build/port/walk_window.map, which only
exists after an MSVC build of the port, and CI on main has no such build.
BEFORE STAMPING, LOOK FOR A BUILD THAT ALREADY EXISTS. Every port lane carries its
own build tree, so a current walk_window.map is usually already on disk:
ls -la */build/port/walk_window.map
across the port worktrees, newest first, then run the tool against that root. The
first version of this file was stamped off a five-day-old branch while a map from
the night before sat unread one directory away, and published 26.5% when the real
figure was 34.5%. A stale stamp is still a real measurement, just of the wrong run.
To refresh: run `python port/tools/linkage.py [root]` and update the numbers below
together with branch, commit and measuredAt. Never move the count without also
moving the provenance fields - tools/tiers.py drops a stamp missing any of them,
which is the intended behaviour for a number nobody can trace.
basis records what the figure is a measurement OF. The port branches are not merged,
so this is the best single lane rather than a combined total. All seven live lanes,
lk5 3819. Overlapping but not identical seats, so the merged figure is higher and
the published number stays a floor.
LINKED grows when matched TUs become reachable in the port's linked call graph.
Actor methods and free functions both count. Enrollment alone does not increase
the count when the release build still dead-strips the unreachable object.
basis: integration branch port/link100 at its pushed tip cb498bcdb, measured against that tip's own battery build walk_window.map (C:/tmp/l1-int, gate FOLD1: tree clean, first build exit 0, linkage 10584 exact with all 61 seated names on their own matched-TU objects, battery ALL GREEN on BOTH arms at floor 10523 with all 51 level and 37 scene rows, ptr_audit 0, the shipping ROM-CLEAN kit built and its selftest green, the six proofs, stage_seat and stage_pause, and three captured runs: level 1 at 300 frames with the selftest position unchanged, level 6 into level 1 across the fader path at 600 frames, and the title screen's own select into level 6), and confirmed by the hosted-runner port-linkage workflow on every push of port/** and every pull request into the shipping branch. +61 over the previous stamp of 10523, +551 over the 2026-09-08 morning's 10033, +1463 over the 2026-08-30 stamp of 9121. Since the 10523 stamp, eight reviewed lanes folded on one integration tip: eighteen ov006 minigame state dispatchers seated on the ROM's own tables with every table's universe proven closed (+18); seventeen slot and calling-convention rows respelled so MSVC emits the ROM's own dispatch (+17); the sound bring-up rungs R2 to R4 as ROM bodies, the cartridge opening its own SDAT off the card with the audio measure identical (+12); four host stand-ins retired for the matched InitResources and ReallocateModelFile bodies (+4); the FaderWipe, Clipper, ShadowModel and Stage vtable words on their matched bodies (+4); two overlay pickups and the EXMEMCNT card-bus wrappers respelled with the register literal (+3); Unagi, MirrorLuigi and the ov102 dispatcher on their tables (+3); and all 23 guessed-vtable bodies adjudicated REAL_DECOMP against the ROM's bytes (0, the policy block lifted). Running: the main -> port sync (builds all but 50 main-owned sources), the four ov015 rows the adjudication freed, and the decomp-side declaration items the seat lanes reported.
